astra.name: Astra Linux
astra.notes: Debian-based. SE: ЗПС ограничивает установку неподписанных пакетов.
warnings: Astra Linux SE runs a closed software environment (ZPS).
Other desktop environments can only be installed on Astra Linux CE or with the closed software environment turned off.
The stock desktop is Fly. GNOME/KDE/XFCE/MATE are not available in the standard repositories.

osnova.name: ОСнова (НППКТ)
osnova.notes: Debian 10 based. Закрытые репозитории, сертификация ФСТЭК.
warnings: OSnova is a closed distribution certified by FSTEC.
Its repositories are not public.
Rexon can manage packages, but the sources of desktop environments are limited.

alt.name: ALT Linux
alt.notes: APT-RPM: команды apt-get, но пакеты RPM. Не путать с Debian!
warnings: ALT Linux uses APT-RPM: apt-get with RPM packages.
Desktop environment package names differ from Debian and Fedora.

simply.name: Simply Linux
simply.notes: ALT-based, для домашних пользователей. XFCE по умолчанию.

rosa.name: ROSA Linux
rosa.notes: dnf с собственными именами пакетов (task-kde, task-gnome).
warnings: ROSA Linux uses its own task-* metapackages.
The standard Fedora comps groups (@kde-desktop) may not work.
Rexon will try Fedora-compatible commands, but the results may differ.

redos.name: РЕД ОС
redos.notes: RHEL/CentOS-based. dnf, близкие к RHEL имена пакетов.
warnings: RED OS is certified by FSTEC. Adding third-party repositories may void the certification.

calculate.name: Calculate Linux
calculate.notes: Полная совместимость с Gentoo. Portage/emerge, те же имена пакетов.

ubuntukylin.name: Ubuntu Kylin
ubuntukylin.notes: Официальный флейвор Ubuntu. ID=ubuntu. Рабочий стол UKUI.

boss.name: BOSS Linux (Bharat OS)
boss.notes: Debian-based. C-DAC India. Рабочий стол Cinnamon по умолчанию. apt/dpkg, стандартные Debian-пакеты.

nixos.name: NixOS
nixos.notes: Декларативная система. Рабочий стол задаётся в /etc/nixos/configuration.nix, Rexon выдаёт готовый snippet и инструкцию nixos-rebuild switch.
warnings: NixOS uses a declarative model: Rexon doesn't install desktop environments with nix-env commands, it gives you a snippet for /etc/nixos/configuration.nix instead.
After adding the snippet, run: sudo nixos-rebuild switch

steamos.name: SteamOS
steamos.notes: Arch-based, корень только для чтения, обновление заменяет образ целиком. Рабочие столы Rexon ставит образами-расширениями systemd-sysext.
warnings: Themes, live wallpapers and the startup movie work on SteamOS and survive system updates.
Xfce, LXQt and Hyprland can be installed on SteamOS: Rexon builds them as system extensions and rebuilds them by itself after every system update.
